cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(MonakaProtocol VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
add_library(monaka_protocol_codec src/codec.cpp src/v2/codec.cpp)
add_library(MonakaProtocol::Codec ALIAS monaka_protocol_codec)
target_compile_features(monaka_protocol_codec PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(monaka_protocol_codec PUBLIC include PRIVATE third_party)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(monaka_protocol_codec PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
else()
  target_compile_options(monaka_protocol_codec PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
option(MONAKA_BUILD_TESTS "Build codec test runner" OFF)
if(MONAKA_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(monaka_codec_runner tests/runner.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(monaka_codec_runner PRIVATE MonakaProtocol::Codec)
  add_test(NAME model_validation COMMAND monaka_codec_runner --self-test)
  add_executable(monaka_codec_runner_v2 tests/runner_v2.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(monaka_codec_runner_v2 PRIVATE MonakaProtocol::Codec)
  add_test(NAME model_validation_v2 COMMAND monaka_codec_runner_v2 --self-test)
endif()
